earlybird-venture-capital._readme: Durable identity corrections consumed by build-company-base.py on every rebuild (COLLECTION.md s8), written by scratch/eb_overlay.py: one company rendered under different names across Earlybird's surfaces (the live Framer lists, the job board, the 2018-2023 WordPress list, the 2014-2017 one-page site, the 2002-2013 pages) and its renames; the rows that are Digital East Fund positions (decisions.md D2: 'desk', lineage digital-east, partitioned as other_desk and preserved in excluded.json); and the non-company rejects.
